meta.attributionSampleNote: Sampled 17 real contacts across recent runs: attributionSource.utmMedium was 'paid' or 'paid_social' for 11/17 (~65%). Directional only, not a full census — do not treat as an exact split.
meta.vipUpgradeNote: Counted via the 'fdr masterclass - vip upgrade' tag (compound filter with each run's registered tag). This tag is legacy-named but still gets applied — however tags persist across re-registrations, so a contact who upgraded on an earlier run and later re-registers for a newer one will show as a VIP upgrade on the newer run too. Small numbers (mostly 0-2 per run) so this rarely matters, but it's not a guaranteed per-run-only count.

meta.revenueDataNote: Revenue/Deals Closed/Cash From Ads/Cash From Organic, pulled 2026-08-13T09:47:00Z, refined 2026-08-13T18:00:00Z per JV's rules: for each run, fetched the run's registered-contact emails from GHL, then joined by email against BigQuery jv-data-warehouse.freedom_academy_au.revenue_transactions (the same table backing the separate FA Revenue Dashboard — 698 rows, $795,669.01 total, synced from the CONSOLIDATED Google Sheet), FILTERED to product IN ('Accelerator','Foundation') AND closer IS NOT NULL (JV: only these products count as Masterclass-contributed revenue; unassigned-closer rows are excluded; no 'Foundation' rows exist in the data yet, filter is ready for when they do) — 218 of 698 transactions / $684,489.01 pass this filter. A transaction only counts toward a run if its date is on/after that run's date — this excludes matched buyers' pre-existing purchases from before they ever registered, which would otherwise misattribute old revenue to a run that didn't generate it. Cash From Ads vs Organic uses the same contact-level attributionSource.utmMedium signal as everything else in this app. Result: only 28 Jul 2026 has real matched revenue ($11,000, 2 deals, both Bruce Notman — a $6,000 and a $5,000 Accelerator purchase 3 days after the run); the other 5 runs are genuinely $0 under this filter (the earlier $97 'per run' figures on 4 Aug/11 Aug were '3D HT Closer Challenge' purchases, correctly excluded now — that product isn't Accelerator/Foundation). Caveats: (1) registered tags persist across re-registrations — a contact registered for two different runs would count toward both, none observed this pull; (2) most of the $795K total revenue (~$658K after the product filter) doesn't match any of the 6 runs' registrants — investigated three Aug 7-11 examples (alexanderlynne12@gmail.com, finc82@hotmail.com, bennyam4646@gmail.com) by hand: all three came through a SEPARATE, untracked Masterclass funnel ('Crypto Collective X FA Masterclass', tags 'crypto fa masterclass - registered/attended', not the per-date 'masterclass - registered D/M' scheme the 6 tracked runs use) — this dashboard doesn't represent that funnel at all yet; (3) revenue is naturally low per run relative to registrant volume since this is a front-end webinar feeding a higher-ticket back-end sales process that plays out over weeks, not the day of.
